Programme Title
Music Performance
Study Scheme
Applicable to students admitted in 2025-26
Major Programme Requirement
Studies in Music Performance are divided into Seven areas of concentration and students are
required to specialize in one of the followings:
(1) Voice;
(2) Strings;
(3) Woodwinds;
(4) Brass;
(5) Piano;
(6) Conducting; and
(7) Percussion.

Study Scheme (English)
Programme Title
Music Performance
Study Scheme
Applicable to students admitted in 2026-27 and thereafter
Major Programme Requirement
Studies in Music Performance are divided into Seven areas of concentration and students are
required to specialize in one of the followings:
(1) Voice;
(2) Strings;
(3) Woodwinds;
(4) Brass;
(5) Piano;
(6) Conducting; and
(7) Percussion.
